lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Hey,

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: are you free?
A villain shouldn't care whether someone else is busy or not.
Sorry, but I'm busy. We can talk later.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: But it'd bum me out if I were to say what I wanted to say

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: and didn't hear a response from you.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Don't lie to me!

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: I only sent you a message

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: after confirming your schedule with Rapi.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Anyway,

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: do you go to the movies often?
I go whenever I'm interested in what's playing.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: You don't say...

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Then allow me to elucidate to you

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: on a few villainous acts you can commit in a movie theater.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: First,

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: you'll need to buy some buttered popcorn and some candy.
Why?

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: How can you not know, you idiot?

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: It's an assault on the senses.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: When the pleasant rattling of that candy in the box hits their ears,

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: and the fresh smell of popcorn hits their nostrils,

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: it will be torture for the other moviegoers who didn't buy anything.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: They'll probably have to run out in the middle of the movie to go buy something.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: That'll surprise the theater employees for sure!

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Mwahahahaha!

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Another question:

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Do you get up right after the end of the movie?
No, I usually stay to see if there's anything after the credits.
Yes, I usually leave once the credits start.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Ah yes, you're clearly in the know.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: But then you're blocking the screen for anyone who's sitting behind you!

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: A true villain must sit and wait until the very end.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Do you want to know why?
Not really.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: That way, your seat will remain warm,

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: and whenever the next person comes in to sit down,

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: they'll be totally grossed out at how uncomfortably warm it is!
Uh-huh.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Most importantly,

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: while you're sitting there waiting and watching the credits,

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: you can memorize the names of the cast and crew.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Then, if you didn't like the movie,

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: you can curse them using their real names!

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Mwahahaha!

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: What a marvelously malicious scheme! It's enough to make even my blood run cold.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Quickly, we must put this plan into action. To the movie theater!

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Meet me there, and don't be late! Mwahahaha!
